items.text: Dinah Shore's "Buttons and Bows" was a number-one song in the United States in 1948, according to Billboard magazine.
items.question: Where were you living when Dinah Shore's "Buttons and Bows" was number one, and who in your house sang along?
source_quote: This is a list of number-one songs in the United States during the year 1948 according to Billboard magazine.
"Buttons and Bows" Dinah Shore and her Happy Valley Boys

items.text: Postage for a domestic letter was 3 cents an ounce.
items.question: Where were you living when a stamp for a letter cost three cents, and who did you write to?

items.text: The ABC television network began broadcasting on April 19, 1948.
items.question: Who was the first person you knew to own a television set when the ABC network began broadcasting, and what did you watch at their house?
items.source_quote: April 19 – The ABC television network begins broadcasting.

items.text: The Cleveland Indians beat the Boston Braves, 4 games to 2, to win the World Series.
items.question: Who in your family followed the World Series between Cleveland and Boston, and how did you hear the games?
items.source_quote: October 11 – The Cleveland Indians defeat the Boston Braves to win the World Series in baseball, 4 games to 2.

items.text: Harry S. Truman defeated Thomas E. Dewey and Strom Thurmond to win the 1948 presidential election.
items.question: Where were you when you heard that Truman had beaten Dewey, and who in your house had been for which man?
items.source_quote: 1948 United States presidential election: Democratic incumbent Harry S. Truman defeats Republican Thomas E. Dewey and 'Dixiecrat' Strom Thurmond.
